vlae.teks: Die son gee elke dag lig en warmte.
vlae.rede: Not a language fault and not changed: the protected 'hitte' entry reserves 'hitte' for energy moving from warm to cold and 'warmte' for the state of being warm, and this sentence sits in the energy block describing what the sun gives. A person may want to confirm 'warmte' is the intended reading here; the sentence reads naturally as it stands.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Nie almal kom ewe maklik daaraan nie
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Daar is ook huise in 'n stad sonder 'n kraan en plase met elektrisiteit en genoeg water.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Party huise in 'n stad het geen kraan nie, en party plase het elektrisiteit en genoeg water.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: As written, 'sonder 'n kraan' can attach to 'stad' and 'sonder ... en plase' can read as 'without a tap and without farms'; two short clauses remove both misreadings with the same word count and meaning.
laat_vaar_vorige.fout: Slight possible misreading of what 'sonder' attaches to, but the sentence is readable as written.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The proposal drops 'Daar is ook', which marks these as counter-examples to the town-versus-remote pattern just described, so the contrast the original draws is weakened.
